Kforce's client is seeking an experienced Full Stack AI Engineer to support the development of innovative, AI-powered applications and solutions. The ideal candidate is a self-motivated, hands-on engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can independently deliver high-quality, production-ready solutions. This role will last 6 months, with potential for conversion to full-time employment. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to high-priority AI initiatives, leveraging modern full stack technologies, generative AI capabilities, and cloud infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and features using model APIs 
  Build and maintain full stack applications using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS 
  Explore and implement AI agents, agentic frameworks, and tool-calling capabilities 
  Develop effective prompt and context designs, structured outputs, and solutions grounded in trusted information 
  Integrate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and knowledge bases into AI applications 
  Implement automated testing, AI evaluation methodologies, and production-quality engineering practices 
  Develop and maintain scalable cloud-based solutions leveraging AWS services 
  Support infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices 
  Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize applications using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing 
  Incorporate security, data privacy, access controls, and responsible AI principles throughout the development lifecycle 
  Collaborate with engineering teams and stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions 
 
 
  Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications or features using model APIs 
  Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript 
  Experience developing modern web applications using React, HTML, and CSS 
  Understanding of prompt engineering, context design, structured outputs, and AI response grounding 
  Familiarity with AI agents, agentic frameworks, and tool calling 
  Knowledge of modern software engineering practices, automated testing, and application troubleshooting 
  Experience working with cloud technologies and CI/CD processes 
  Strong problem-solving abilities, communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to work independently 
  Ability to quickly learn new technologies and deliver high-quality solutions in a collaborative engineering environment 

 
Preferred Qualifications:
 
  Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), semantic search, and knowledge bases 
  Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks and testing methodologies 
  Experience with AWS services, including Bedrock, AgentCore, ECS, EKS, and MSK 
  Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code technologies 
  Familiarity with observability tools, including logging, metrics, and tracing 
  Understanding of AI security considerations, including prompt injection, data privacy, and access management 

 
Additional Information:
Candidates are not expected to have experience with every technology listed. Equivalent technical experience, strong engineering fundamentals, and a demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to emerging AI technologies are highly valued.
